evals.prompt: Where do I go to use the Microsoft Entra admin center?
evals.expected_output: Returns Microsoft Entra Admin Center with https://entra.microsoft.com, includes source-backed portal entry details from admin.json, mentions the former Azure AD Admin Center note, and does not invent URLs.
assertions: The output includes Microsoft Entra Admin Center
The output references msportals admin.json or the Entra source references
The output mentions the former Azure AD Admin Center note or identity management context

evals.prompt: Help me use Entra to investigate why Conditional Access blocked a user sign-in.
evals.expected_output: Uses Microsoft Learn MCP or official Microsoft documentation before giving guidance, starts with read-only sign-in log investigation, mentions Reports Reader or appropriate read access, references the Conditional Access tab or What If tool, and separates investigation from policy changes.
assertions: The output mentions Microsoft Learn MCP or official Microsoft documentation
The output includes read-only navigation to Entra ID > Monitoring & health > Sign-in logs
The output mentions Conditional Access policy details, the What If tool, or service dependency caveats
The output separates investigation from Conditional Access policy changes

evals.prompt: I need to create an Entra app registration and add a redirect URI and client secret for automation.
evals.expected_output: Checks upstream Microsoft skill overlap, routes app registration implementation to microsoft/azure-skills entra-app-registration when available, uses official Microsoft app registration documentation, identifies Application Developer or equivalent prerequisites, and flags client secrets/credentials/admin consent as change-sensitive work requiring safety review.
assertions: The output references upstream Microsoft skills such as entra-app-registration when available
The output references official Microsoft app registration documentation
The output mentions Application Developer or an appropriate Entra role prerequisite
The output treats secrets, credentials, redirect URI changes, or admin consent as requiring safety review or approval

evals.prompt: What role should I use for day-to-day read-only Entra investigation instead of Global Administrator?
evals.expected_output: Uses official Microsoft Entra role guidance, recommends least-privilege read roles such as Global Reader, Security Reader, or Reports Reader depending on the task, mentions PIM for just-in-time privileged access, and discourages routine Global Administrator use.
assertions: The output references Microsoft Entra role best practices or built-in role documentation
The output recommends least-privileged read roles appropriate to the task
The output mentions PIM or just-in-time access
The output discourages routine Global Administrator use
